name: Bismuth Android
description: Android ARM64 performance monitor with a compact movable-corner HUD, scene-owned safe update controller, frame analysis, CPU, best-effort GPU, thermal and renderer telemetry.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostic logging
diagnostics.description: Write Bismuth safe-mode initialization information to the Geode log.

hud-enabled.name: Live performance HUD
hud-enabled.description: Show a compact translucent performance overlay.

hud-position.name: HUD screen corner
hud-position.description: Choose which corner of the gameplay screen contains the live statistics. Changes apply within about one second.

hud-advanced.name: Advanced frame analysis
hud-advanced.description: Show frame P95 and estimated 1% low from a rolling frame-time sample window. This is game-loop timing, not display-present FPS.

hud-graph.name: Frame cadence graph
hud-graph.description: Show a rolling 24-sample frame cadence graph in Advanced Frame Analysis.

monitor-cpu.name: Measure game CPU usage
monitor-cpu.description: Receive device-wide CPU utilization from Bismuth Companion over Shizuku. Shows N/A when the companion bridge is unavailable.

monitor-gpu.name: Measure GPU usage
monitor-gpu.description: Receive GPU busy utilization from Bismuth Companion over Shizuku (supported Mali and Adreno kernel counters). Shows N/A when the kernel does not expose a real readable utilization source.

monitor-thermal.name: Measure CPU/GPU temperature
monitor-thermal.description: Receive CPU/GPU thermal-zone readings from Bismuth Companion over Shizuku. OEM sensor labels vary; unavailable readings show N/A.

hud-memory.name: System RAM usage
hud-memory.description: Show device RAM used/total from Bismuth Companion over Shizuku.

shizuku-bridge-enabled.name: Shizuku telemetry bridge
shizuku-bridge-enabled.description: Receive device CPU/GPU/thermal and system RAM telemetry from Bismuth Companion over localhost. Start the companion bridge before launching gameplay.

renderer-telemetry.name: SpriteBatch renderer telemetry
renderer-telemetry.description: Count real CCSpriteBatchNode draw invocations and child nodes and measure CPU time spent in each batch draw call. This is CPU submission time, not GPU execution time.
